snippet.title: Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted™ Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order Replanted now! https://go.ea.com/PvZReplanted
The lawn is back, and it’s never looked this good! 💚

Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted brings the original classic back to life with stunning new visuals, brand-new modes, and all the chaotic charm you remember. Build your defense. Blast the undead. Repeat!

From challenge modes to the return of every fan-favorite plant and zombie, this is PvZ reimagined for a new generation. 

Ready to defend your lawn again? 🌻

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/plantsvszombies
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/officialpvz/
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/plantsversuszombies/
